goals.text: The decision to build the history scan rests on measured recall, precision and cost.

outcomes.change: A prototype measures the filter and the judge on this repository's history
outcomes.checked_by: the README states recall and narrowing per threshold, judge recall with its Wilson interval, false-alarm rate and precision, cost per unit and per range, record-only positives apart, and the verdict against the bars set here, each produced by a script in the folder from results in the folder; a test that rerunning the units and score scripts reproduces the README's filter numbers; kmctl check and strict OKF validation

problems.text: Nobody knows whether a filter plus a judge finds unrecorded decisions well enough to build into kmctl.
